provider: MacStadium - Mac Cloud Compute, plan M4.S Mac mini (Apple M4 10-core, 16 GB, 256 GB SSD), dedicated bare metal
region_dc: Dublin, Ireland (MacStadium first EU DC and international HQ). Other DCs: Atlanta, Las Vegas (US). Region selection for self-serve portal order [uncertain]
sovereignty_class: US-HQ operator (North American HQ Atlanta, Irish subsidiary) with EU DC = CLOUD Act exposure, not full EU sovereignty. Certifications per MacStadium legal page as relayed by third party: SOC 3, ISO 27001/27017/27018; datacenters page says SOC 2 Type II. No SecNumCloud, BSI C5 or HDS found. [uncertain: certificate scope per DC]
monthly_cost: USD 149/mo list (checked on macstadium.com/pricing, Oct 2026) = approx EUR 128-137/mo depending on FX, excl. VAT [uncertain: FX]. Always-on flat; no per-hour option, so POC-hours cost equals a full month (no proration on cancel). Fits under EUR 150 budget only barely, with zero headroom for anything else.
billing_granularity: Monthly prepaid, billed on first day of month for next 30 days, auto-renews; USD only. No per-hour, no scale-to-zero. Annual terms (1-3 yr) also offered. Card at purchase; Net 15 invoice for orders over USD 1,000 (third-party source) [uncertain]
setup_fee_and_lockin: No setup fee found. Month-to-month, cancel via portal; Mac goes offline and data destroyed within 24h; no refund or proration of remaining month. No free trial. 1-3 year terms optional for discount [uncertain: discount size].
gen_tps_7b_q4: Approx 20-24 t/s [uncertain: bandwidth-derived, not measured on this host]. M4 base = 120 GB/s; 4.5 GB model gives ~26 t/s theoretical ceiling; llama.cpp typically reaches ~80-90 percent on Apple silicon Metal.
prefill_tps: Approx 200-250 t/s [uncertain: extrapolated from public llama.cpp Apple-silicon benchmarks for M4 10-GPU, 7B Q4]. Weak for agentic workloads with large tool schemas.
ttft_at_4k: Approx 16-20 s at 4k prompt tokens [uncertain: derived from prefill estimate]; prompt caching of the static tool-schema prefix (llama.cpp cache_prompt) would cut repeat turns sharply.
concurrency_slots: 1-2 slots realistic; throughput is memory-bandwidth-bound so extra slots split decode speed. KV cache for Mistral-style 7B (32 layers, 8 KV heads, fp16) approx 0.125 GB per 1k tokens [uncertain: depends on exact Bielik variant]; q8_0 KV halves it.
ctx_ram_headroom: 16 GB unified. macOS plus services approx 3-4 GB; Metal default GPU-wired cap approx 10.7 GB (raisable via iogpu.wired_limit_mb sysctl with root, which is granted). Model 4.5 GB + KV: 16k ctx approx 2 GB, 32k approx 4 GB fits; 32k with q8 KV comfortable. Practical max approx 32k at 1-2 slots [uncertain: not measured].
availability_status: M4.S listed as available now via self-serve portal (portal.macstadium.com, account needed for live inventory and quote) [uncertain: live stock in Dublin not verifiable without login]. Pricing page says M5/M6 minis are available only through sales (no public price); M5/M6 not verified for Dublin.
egress_traffic: Unlimited bandwidth on 1 Gbps port included in flat rate; dedicated IPv4 included. No overage cost stated.
electricity_metering: Not metered separately; power included in flat monthly price. Mac mini M4 draws roughly 5-40 W under load (vendor-reported, not billed).
hosting_model: Self-host llama.cpp (llama-server) on bare-metal macOS with full root access; full control over chat template and tool-call parsing (--jinja). Run as launchd service. Screen Sharing blocked from internet, access via SSH or VPN/tunnel.
tool_calling_support: Via llama-server --jinja: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with server-side tool parsing, depending on the Bielik chat template quality [uncertain: Bielik template tool-call format needs testing].
spec_decode_support: Yes in principle. llama.cpp on Metal supports draft models (-md / --draft); small draft model adds little RAM on 16 GB but speedup on bandwidth-bound M4 not measured [uncertain]. Root access allows any build.
sla_uptime: SLA 99.9 percent monthly with service credits (10 percent below 99.9, 25 percent below 99, 50 percent below 98), claim within 7 days; marketing states 99.99 percent uptime. No GPU-grade SLA. Free Basic support 9-5 local time by ticket; paid tiers 10-20 percent of annual spend, annual terms only (third-party source) [uncertain].
llm_inference_tos: No restriction on LLM inference found; root-access dedicated hardware, general-purpose use. Full ToS/AUP not read in detail [uncertain].
price_stability: M4.S at USD 149 on current page; third-party comparison (myremotemac) also cites USD 149, no price change history found in sources [uncertain]. Billed in USD, so EUR cost carries FX risk. Cheaper rivals exist: Mac mini M4 16GB at USD 85 (My Remote Mac, location unverified) and M6 at USD 139 (MacRun, US-only).
model_lock_in: None. Self-hosted GGUF; any model can be loaded. Only lock-in is monthly hardware commitment and USD billing.
